set.body: Address six verified post-closure findings: achieved solver guarantees, certified chart laws, complete objective bindings, enforceable fold provenance, exact overlapping-group lifting, and sparse/allocation-aware lifecycle execution. Completion requires shared regression tests on JVM and Scala.js, IR validation coverage where applicable, focused multivar and multivar-ir suites, and a clean full repository gate from a detached worktree.
set.title: EPIC: harden multivar contracts from post-closure review
